sibling_models.justification: Both EfficientNetB7 and ResNet-50 are part of convolutional neural network families designed for image classification tasks.
Both EfficientNetB7 and ResNet-56 belong to architectures aimed at image-related tasks.
EfficientNetB7 and DenseNet-121 are both part of convolutional neural network families emphasizing connectivity patterns to improve image classification performance.
EfficientNet models and MobileNet are both designed to be efficient and lightweight, optimized for running on mobile and edge devices.

closest_sibling_model.justification: EfficientNet and MobileNet share a common focus on model efficiency and lightweight characteristics ideal for mobile devices.
